title: Joseph: A Feared Master from Birth
original_title: Joseph: A Feared Master from Birth
overview: An AI Generated telling of the biblical story of Joseph, the favored son of Jacob, who is betrayed by his jealous brothers and sold into slavery in Egypt. Despite facing hardship, false accusations, and imprisonment, Joseph remains faithful and gains a reputation for interpreting dreams. When Pharaoh is troubled by mysterious dreams, Joseph is brought before him and successfully reveals their meaning, predicting a coming famine. As a result, Joseph is elevated to a position of great authority in Egypt, where he oversees the preparation that saves many lives. Years later, his brothers come to Egypt seeking food, leading to a powerful reunion that tests forgiveness, redemption, and God's greater plan.
